column1: # The e2e cases: where each one runs, how long it takes and what it reads.
# scripts/ci/e2e-shards.sh reads this file to split the cases over the
#   case     the file name in tests/e2e without .sh
#   stage    base: runs in the job "e2e base", whose outputs every shard gets;
#            shard: runs in exactly one of the shard jobs
#   seconds  the median time of the case in the passing runs it was measured on
#   needs    the shard-stage cases whose outputs it reads, comma-separated, or -
#            for none; a case runs in the same shard as every case it needs,
# A case with no row runs as a shard case of 300 seconds that needs nothing.
# Stage base holds the numbered cases and bash-step-08-hla: most other cases
# read what they wrote. The needs come from what each case says it reads (its
# header and its checks) and from the cases that failed when a need was
# missing. A run of the E2E workflow by hand with trace: true measures the
# times again and prints a new file in its summary; its traced needs are an
# upper bound to check by hand (docs/testing.md).
